name: Sauce Essentials Live Resin Disposable | Super Blue Dream
description:
Super Blue Dream is fast-acting and known for creating head-heavy effects. This strain is energizing

and great for daytime use. While Super Blue Dream is powerful, it still allows you to focus and get things done. Similar to its Blue Dream parent, Super Blue Dream features a sour blueberry aroma.

Taste: Berry, Blueberry, Citrus, Sweet

Feel: Euphoria, Focus, Happy, Uplifting

Strain: Blue Dream x Super Silver Haze
